title: Measurement of Jugular Venous Pulse in Critically Ill Patients.
brief_summary: To assess the utility of clinical bedside examination for the measurement of jugular venous pulse in critically ill patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients admitted to the ICU who have existing central venous catheters.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients admitted to the ICU who do not have existing central venous catheters
condition: Jugular Venous Pulse Measurement in Critically Ill Patients
